description: This file defines an Angular service TaskService that provides CRUD operations for managing tasks via REST API calls. It includes methods for listing, creating, updating, deleting, and toggling task completion, with internal logic for normalizing backend data and handling HTTP errors.

classes.name: TaskService
classes.description: An Angular service providing CRUD operations for tasks via REST API.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Transforms raw backend task objects into the Task interface, normalizing IDs and date fields.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Fetches all tasks from the backend API.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new task with provided partial data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing task identified by ID with partial data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a task identified by ID.

methods.name: toggleComplete
methods.description: Shortcut method to toggle the completion status of a task.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles HTTP errors, converting them into user-friendly error messages.
